decisions.reason: The image instructions are an independent clause already fully represented by the candidate's message-207 MODIFY; the internal-link change requires no additional image-state change.
The existing prerequisite that required internal links be added before publication remains valid without changing the publication requirement's state.
The word-count instruction is an independent clause already represented by the candidate's message-207 INTRODUCE; the internal-link modification adds no further word-count change.
Changing internal-link applicability and destinations does not alter the AI dolls blog's target audience.
Applying internal-link rules to each blog does not change the agreed article type, trial inclusion, or article count.
The internal-link modification does not change topic suggestions, topic revision constraints, or the topic-and-keyword document requirement.
The source decision concerns internal-link placement and destinations, not blog keyword selection.
The SEO plan's included service areas and exclusions remain unchanged; mentioning blogs does not modify the planning deliverable.
The internal-link decision does not affect keyword count, search-volume data, or replacement keywords in the research report.
